articleBody:
A full-scope kitchen overhaul involves complex moving parts, from structural framing to coordinated plumbing rough-ins. Use this preparation checklist before construction starts to keep your remodel running smoothly from day one.

- [ ] Accurate cabinet blueprint drawings signed off by the installer — Ensures all wall dimensions, ceiling heights, and appliance clearances align before manufacturing begins.
- [ ] Appliance specification sheets with exact cutout dimensions collected — Prevents cabinetry and countertop misfits during final trim installation.
- [ ] Confirmed written building permits from your local building department — Protects you against stop-work orders and validates that plumbing, gas, and electrical work satisfy local codes.
- [ ] Written trade coordination schedule from your general contractor — Clarifies when framing, rough mechanicals, drywall hanging, and finish tile will occur.
- [ ] Defined change-order clause outlining written approvals and rates — Keeps budget expectations transparent if rotted subfloors or outdated wiring appear inside opened walls.
- [ ] Dedicated temporary kitchen setup outside the active construction zone — Keeps daily living functional with a microwave, portable cooler, and clean water access while main utilities are disconnected.
- [ ] Material delivery storage space designated in a dry garage or spare room — Keeps custom trim, flooring boxes, and tile pallets protected from site debris and foot traffic.
- [ ] Itemized contract listing fixture and finish selections by manufacturer model number — Eliminates vague allowance estimates that create surprise expenses at final billing.

How to use this checklist:
Review these items with your general contractor during your pre-construction walk-through. Having verified measurements, product cut sheets, and clear permit documentation in place prevents costly work stops once demo starts. For hands-on help planning your full kitchen renovation in Aurora and the Denver area, call Abraham Becerra at HH Remodeling LLC at 303-505-0866.
